output.conditional_row_count_assumption: All successes use native Engine EOS/max_frames termination with no cancellation. First frame uses prefill hidden; each non-limit request needs one terminal EOS decode. Raw PCM does not expose finish reason.

dispatch.pairing_basis: Closed-loop worker has no await between end timestamp / PCM accounting / next request dispatch; sorted first N-C completions pair with the N-C refill dispatches. This is client processing/loop gap, not server admission delay.

reference_budget.limitations: Reference assumes continuous full B64 at one isolated measured step duration; does not include prompt/first-frame work, incomplete batches, state/context variation, resource contention or transport. It is neither a proven hardware upper bound nor a guaranteed serving lower bound.

pure_decode_call_row_padding.limitation: Call-row weighting; use conditional_decode_row_accounting for observed execution-step weighting.

limitations: All events selected by CPU submission time inside the measured request window; phase is a client submission proxy, not a GPU execution boundary.
Event spans include possible host launch gaps; union is not kernel busy time or SM utilization.
codec_submit is nested host submission scope; excluded from model and codec compute-stage unions, retained in all-recorded union.
Overlap groups with equal active count still differ in context lengths, execution time, and cache/resource history; observed differences do not prove a causal codec slowdown.
mixed_backbone contains prefill teacher tower; first_frame CPU time may wait for prior mixed GPU work.
New rich records expose prompt token/capacity/span, decode steps and codec job partitions; active/pending queue depths and model context lengths remain unavailable.
No synchronous historical profile proportion was transferred to this asynchronous profile.

conditional_decode_row_accounting.assumptions: Steps and padded_batch are recorded directly; all model executions count, including a graph step after native EOS within a multistep event. Conditional productive rows are retained separately.

reference_gap_decomposition.limitations: Algebraic account of the isolated-B64 reference gap, not additive recoverable speedups. Mixed residual includes required prompt and teacher/first-frame work; decode residual includes underfill, context, codec contention and launch effects.

matched_overlap_association.interpretation: Observed same-active (57..64), same-steps, same-client-intake phase association relative to no-overlap group mean, not causal or guaranteed recoverable; context/cache history still uncontrolled.

codec_recorded_partition_accounting.caveat: Minimum legal launches holds currently ready frame buckets fixed, uses captured max_batch16 and max_padded_frames512; does not claim lower latency, identical BF16 rounding, or safe cross-bucket coalescing.
